note: The Federated States of Micronesia issues no national identity card: its officially recognised legal identity is the birth certificate, and a national ID system is planned but not yet implemented (SEAP digital ID overview).

sources.title: Institute on Statelessness and Inclusion / SEAP, Digital ID overview: the Federated States of Micronesia
sources.said: The officially recognized legal identity in Micronesia is a birth certificate. ... Once implemented, the national ID system will be linked to public and private sector services,
